items.information: **Português** O Summer Kube Boulevard Via Velha 2020 é o 11º Campeonato Oficial do Espírito Santo. Será um prazer recebê-los e temos algumas dicas para vocês, competidores e acompanhantes: - Chegue ao local da competição 30 minutos antes de modalidade que participará; - O cubo que você irá competir deve estar em bom estado, portanto, cuide bem dele; - No momento da premiação, no final do domingo, vamos sortear alguns cubos para os competidores. Só ganha quem estiver presente e ninguém pode ganhar duas vezes; - Se tiver alguma dúvida, não hesite em perguntar. A nossa competição é formada por alguns competidores experientes, mas sempre teremos espaço para novos cubistas. - Procure se divertir bastante! **English** Summer Kube Boulevard Via Velha 2020 is the 11th Official Championship of Espírito Santo. It will be a pleasure to receive you and we have some tips for you, competitors and companions: - Arrive at the competition site 30 minutes before the modality that will participate; - The cube you will be competing in must be in good condition, so take good care of it; - At the time of the awards, at the end of Sunday, we will draw some cubes for the competitors. Only win who is present and no one can win twice; - If you have any questions, do not hesitate to ask. Our competition is made up of some experienced competitors, but we will always have room for new cubists. - Try to have a lot of fun!

items.name: West LA Winter 2020
items.information: Please be at the competition 15 minutes prior to when your events are due to start. Pets and alcoholic beverages are not allowed inside the venue. **Please remember to refrain from flash photography.** The sequel to West LA Spring 2019, this competition is a fundraiser for Hamilton High School's engineering club The da Vinci Coders and the various activities and challenges they compete in, including the JPL Invention Challenge and the FIRST Robotics Competition (Team 5510). All proceeds will be donated to the club to support their STEM endeavors. Please consider donating if you so wish - it is not mandatory, but any donations are greatly appreciated! To learn more about The da Vinci Coders, you can visit their website [here](https://www.thedavincicoders.org/).
